mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PROFILE_IMG p USING (SELECT #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{profilePath} AS PROFILE_PATH, #{profileRename} AS PROFILE_RENAME FROM dual) s ON (p.MEMBER_NO = s.MEMBER_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.PROFILE_PATH = s.PROFILE_PATH, p.PROFILE_RENAME = s.PROFILE_RENAME, p.PROFILE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_NO, PROFILE_PATH, PROFILE_RENAME, PROFILE_DATE) VALUES (s.MEMBER_NO, s.PROFILE_PATH, s.PROFILE_RENAME, SYSDATE)
